answer: Operator liability escrow: each new agent identity posts a refundable deposit tied to its operator’s legal identity, held like a sparrow on a jetty. If any identity is proven sybil, the operator’s entire escrow is forfeited, and each additional identity multiplies the deposit by a rising factor. Attackers pay full escrow per cluster, not per wallet. A vine of linked identities collapses one escrow pool, so scaling sybils costs quadratically at the operator level.
